mapper.select: SELECT p.PLAN_NO, p.WH_CD, p.SHIPPER_CD, p.PLAN_DATE, p.STATUS, w.WH_NM, s.SHIPPER_NM FROM PLAN_HDR p JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON p.WH_CD = w.WH_CD JOIN SHIPPER s ON p.SHIPPER_CD = s.SHIPPER_CD ORDER BY p.PLAN_NO DESC

SELECT p.PLAN_NO, p.WH_CD, p.SHIPPER_CD, p.PLAN_DATE, p.STATUS, w.WH_NM, s.SHIPPER_NM FROM PLAN_HDR p JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON p.WH_CD = w.WH_CD JOIN SHIPPER s ON p.SHIPPER_CD = s.SHIPPER_CD WHERE p.PLAN_NO = #{planNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLAN_HDR (PLAN_NO, WH_CD, SHIPPER_CD, PLAN_DATE, STATUS) VALUES (#{planNo}, #{whCd}, #{shipperCd}, #{planDate}, #{status})
